meta.model: 2PL: P(right) = 1 / (1 + exp(-a * (theta - b))); theta of the fitted students has mean 0 and sd 1
meta.fit: MAP, full-batch Adam, 600 steps, lr 0.05; priors theta ~ N(0,1), b ~ N(0,2^2), log a ~ N(0,0.7^2)
meta.first_answer: the earliest answer per (student, problem); right = discrete_score >= 1
